item.title: Nvidia's Huang To Skip India AI Impact Summit
item.description: Nvidia Corporation (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang will skip next week's India AI Impact Summit, surprising industry observers and policymakers. The event aims to showcase India's growing ambitions in artificial intelligence and global technology leadership, reports Reuters. Huang had planned media engagements in New Delhi before the summit's opening ceremony, led by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. item.title: Jury: Johnson & Johnson Liabile in Case Linking Baby Powder to Cancer
